title: Article 3-2 Article 3-2  If the person making a juridical act did not have mental capacity when manifesting the relevant intention, the juridical act is void.
statute_text:
Article 3-2 Article 3-2  If the person making a juridical act did not have mental capacity when manifesting the relevant intention, the juridical act is void.
Section 3 Capacity to Act
(Age of Majority)

variables.description: The individual performing a legal action.
A legal act performed by an individual.
The mental ability to understand and perform a legal action.
The intent behind the legal action.

predicates.description: The juridical act performed by a person.
predicates.supporting_span: the person making a juridical act

predicates.description: Whether the person has mental capacity.
The act of manifesting the relevant intention.

rules.supporting_span: If the person making a juridical act did not have mental capacity when manifesting the relevant intention, the juridical act is void.
rules.explanation: A juridical act performed by a person without mental capacity at the time of expressing intent is considered void.
